subject: t-sc
title: T.SC.------INT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 135 (ALT(FT)II-29). T-SC (theoretical science) is the subject; INT (intention) is the partner. From the subject: POST (postulation), TECH-DY (technological dynamics) and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From POST: AFI (affinity insight). From TECH-DY: FUND-P (fundamental particulars). From EXP-DY: BIA (bi-aitional). From AFI: INT-2 (intention) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From BIA: INFO-CON (information convergence) and C-INFO (composite information). From PER-DY: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From C-INFO: OBS (observation).
